proposals.title: Embed the live H Agent View in-app, beside the streaming timeline
proposals.what: AgentViewPanel receives agentViewUrl but only renders a text link. Add an <iframe src={agentViewUrl}> pane next to the cyan step timeline so judges watch the real browser being driven live inside your own UI. Keep the existing 'Watch live' link as a guaranteed fallback and hide the iframe on load-error/timeout in case platform.hcompany.ai sends X-Frame-Options.
proposals.why: Turns the strongest browser-surface moment from an invisible link into something the room actually sees; safe fallback means it can never break the demo.

proposals.title: Desktop Cam: frame the real WhatsApp window during negotiation
proposals.what: The desktop agent already activates WhatsApp and force-sends via osascript. Add a /demo presenter layout (or OBS scene) that mirrors the actual WhatsApp desktop window on the projector while the agent types + sends, plus a slim in-app overlay ('H desktop agent is operating WhatsApp'). Mostly staging, no change to the H session code.
proposals.why: The un-fakeable money shot: judges watch a cursor type and hit send in a real Mac app. This is the single biggest 'whoa' and it's currently happening off-frame.

proposals.title: 'Saved you $X' negotiation-win callout on booking
proposals.what: Listing price and the agent's agreed_price / viewing_time already flow back through _apply_turn_result and the concierge 'Booked!' message. On booking, show a big 'Negotiated $2450 -> $2300 · saved $150/mo · viewing Sat 2pm' callout in-app and in the Telegram confirmation.
proposals.why: Proves the agent didn't just message an owner, it haggled and won real money — the line judges repeat back.

proposals.title: Full-screen 'THE AGENT IS NEGOTIATING FOR YOU' state with real chat bubbles
proposals.what: Owner/agent turns already arrive tagged (classify() handles owner:/agent:; contact-svc emits Owner:/Agent: events). Promote the small contacting side-panel to a projector-readable hero overlay that renders the turns as green/gray WhatsApp-style bubbles in a phone frame, with a big 'Negotiating…' headline and the live timer.
proposals.why: Makes 'it's really having a back-and-forth conversation' legible from the back of the room, at the demo's emotional peak.

proposals.title: Sound + confetti cues on send and on 'Booked!'
proposals.what: There's no audio today and the reply Toast is silent. Add a Web Audio 'send' blip when the agent fires a message and a triumphant chime + confetti burst when phase becomes replied/booked. No assets required (Web Audio API + CSS/canvas confetti).
proposals.why: Sound at the climax is literally what makes a room react audibly; costs almost nothing.

proposals.title: Persistent '2 computer-use agents' HUD badge
proposals.what: Add a header chip with a browser glyph and a desktop glyph that pulse when each surface is live (browser during discovering, desktop during contacting). Reuse the existing .pulse keyframe.
proposals.why: Continuously advertises the rare dual computer-use claim instead of relying on the narrator to say it once.

proposals.title: Staggered live pin-drop animation as listings arrive
proposals.what: finishDiscovery currently sets all listings at once so the map pops fully formed. Drop the pins one-by-one with a short bounce while the Agent View streams steps, so the map visibly fills live as the agent scrolls Craigslist. Purely front-end/cosmetic, no risk to the H session.
proposals.why: Turns a static reveal into a suspenseful 'it's finding them right now' beat.

proposals.title: Telegram 'typing…' beats + live-streamed negotiation, optional QR to H live view
proposals.what: The concierge already forwards Owner:/Agent: lines to chat. Add sendChatAction:typing before each agent line and pace them so the judge's own phone lights up with the back-and-forth in real time. Optionally attach the H live-view link as a QR so judges can open the session on their own phones.
proposals.why: Makes the 'I just texted it and it did the errand' hook tangible in the judge's hand during the pitch.
